items.title: 6.3.4 Enthalpy change of atomization (atomization ki enthalpy change) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.3.4, printed page 121.

blocks.title: Enthalpy change of atomization
blocks.text: Kisi element ki standard enthalpy change of atomization woh enthalpy change hai jo tab hoti hai jab us element se gaseous atoms ka ek mole standard conditions par banta hai.

blocks.text_alt: ½ H₂(g) → H(g)    ΔH°at = +218 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Pehli equation mein H₂ ka ek mole toot kar 2 mole H atoms deta hai (yeh H–H bond energy, 436 hai). Atomization ki definition mein sirf ek mole atoms chahiye, is liye ½H₂ lete hain aur value aadhi ho jati hai: 436 ÷ 2 = 218 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: Atomization ki enthalpy hamesha positive kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Atoms alag karne ke liye bonds (ya metal ke andar ki forces) torne parte hain, aur torne mein energy absorb hoti hai. Is liye ΔH°at hamesha positive (endothermic) hai.

items: ΔH°at: element se gaseous atoms ka ek mole; hamesha endothermic; hydrogen ke liye +218 kJ mol⁻¹, yani H–H bond energy 436 ka aadha.
